intelligence.human_view: Think of it like a house where every room already exists — and someone keeps proposing to build a new wing every time they want a new view. Shawn's answer, ten times in one morning, was: no new wing. The news doesn't need a new feed; it needs the blocks we already have, one story to one post, in the Hub we already have, with three pills swapped. The block doesn't need a fancier name; it needs the plainest one — headline, then story — and the word "hook" goes because a hook sounds like a trick and a story sounds like the truth. The boards don't need a new pattern; they need their own colours, in order, so scrolling feels like walking through the spectrum. The comment area doesn't need a heading; it needs the writing box first, because writing is what you came to do. The month doesn't need the date in a fancy font; only the name takes the fancy font, and numbers stay numbers. And the sidebar doesn't need a new design; it needs the beautiful one put back, with a choice the citizen can actually rely on — because a door that opens once and never again is not a door.
intelligence.simple_view:
Every block starts with a big headline!
Then comes the story underneath it.
The word hook is gone, because the hook IS the story!
News is not a new page.
It is the same Hub with different pills!
Tap LOCAL or GLOBAL and see that world!
Each board lights up in its own color as you scroll!
In the comment area, you write first!
Only November gets the fancy font, and numbers stay as real number tiles!
And YOU choose your sidebar — or none at all!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — every block starts with a big headline, dear, and then the story right underneath, plain as day! The word hook is gone, love — because it was always a story, just called by a silly name! The news needs nothing new, dear — the same Hub, the same boards, just three new little pills to tap! Each board lights up in its own lovely color as you scroll, love, one after another like a rainbow! And in the comments, dear, you write first — the box is right there at the top, waiting for you! Only November gets the fancy writing, love, and the numbers stay as real numbers! And YOU choose your sidebar, dear — or none at all — and whichever you choose, it simply has to work!
intelligence.naya_view: The order is SN-3732: answer every question in a smart note, auto-categorized, right away — the feed is the front door. The design that carries it: block opens "Headline", story directly underneath, never "in a nutshell", never "feature story"; "hook" renamed "story" everywhere — search the whole tree and swap it. News renders as intelligent blocks in the Hub feed, one post per story, smart note per topic, links as buttons; no separate news worker, no three crons, and never claim it runs itself until the crons exist. News hub is the Hub's middle feed with LOCAL / PROVINCIAL / GLOBAL pills; each pill filters to its scope; nothing else changes. Boards light around the edge in the full spectrum, sidebar sequence, as they scroll; no white/purple repeat; Dashboard purple, Business green. Comment area: entry first at top, chips smaller below, prompt as an elevated statement block at the bottom, no heading; COMMENT centered green, SHARE INTEL in the corner; the 'Welcome' pill's purpose still owed. Date header: only "November" in the certificate font; the 19 in dashboard digit tiles with the green edge; time in its own button centered under the month; "Thursday the 19th" to the left. Sidebar restored, colour-aligned with the left; citizen chooses IM bar, DM bar, sidebar, or neither; every option opens and closes reliably; Messenger never opens empty. Prove it all on the page at 390 and 1920.
